visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with exceptionally long, brown, wavy hair stands in a bright indoor room. She wears a white collared shirt and has colorful bracelets on her wrists. The background includes a large arched wooden mirror and a vintage-style radio on a side table. (2) The girl sits in a professional barber's chair, laughing with her mouth wide open, exhibiting high excitement. A stylist's hands appear, using blue clips to section her thick hair. The setting is a minimalist studio with light wooden floors and white walls. (3) The hairdresser uses golden scissors to cut off large bundles of the girl's hair while she is draped in a black salon cape. She watches with a mix of anticipation and joy. Small cut hairs are visible on the cape's surface. (4) An electric clipper is used to shave the sides of her head, creating a buzzed undercut style. The girl smiles at the camera while a woman in a green floral dress walks by in the background holding a smartphone. (5) The girl has her hair washed in a white ceramic salon sink and then dried with a black hairdryer. The stylist continues to refine the cut. Two younger children enter and react with dramatic expressions of surprise. (6) A tall man with a shaved head and an orange t-shirt enters and reacts with a shocked expression. The girl holds up a plastic bag containing her tied-up hair for donation. The video ends with a close-up of her new short hairstyle.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track begins with a high-pitched, energetic young girl's voice speaking in Mandarin, set against an upbeat acoustic pop BGM with bright guitar strumming. (2) Sharp, percussive scissor 'snip' sounds occur repeatedly, layered with the girl's excited laughter and occasional conversational interjections from an adult female. (3) A steady, low-frequency buzzing from electric clippers enters, shifting the acoustic texture while the BGM maintains a consistent upbeat tempo. (4) The sound of splashing water and gentle scrubbing signifies a hair wash, during which vocal arousal momentarily drops to a calmer conversational level. (5) A loud whirring from a hairdryer dominates the mid-range, followed by a burst of high-arousal cheering and yelling from multiple children. (6) A deep-pitched adult male voice shouts with a surprised inflection. The BGM fades as final conversational exchanges about donating the cut hair occur.

The primary focus is on her excitement, the stylization process, and the wholesome reactions of her family members, promoting a sense of joy and charitable action.
